top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Drop on Samsung, Alibaba; Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks declined, with the artificial intelligence trade in early focus during a week set to be shaped by earnings from chip bellwether Nvidia Corp. and the Federal Reserve’s annual gathering. Oil fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Ramp Up Dollar Shorts Ahead of Bessent’s Fiscal Plan
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds are ramping up bearish dollar bets as they await more details on Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s new fiscal plan to address the highest borrowing costs in years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Browns coach says Deshaun Watson’s comments about fans will not impact QB decision
top_signals.summary: Watson alluded to his belief that he would be facing "17 away games" if he were named the starter.
